name: ShadedVolumeStyle
aliases: ShadedVolumeStyle — Blender Volume Rendering (2.6), ISOSurfaceVolumeStyle, Volume rendering (Blender)
definition: A rendering style node that calculates and applies lighting effects to the visual output. It uses an emission-absorption model with a single scattering approximation. Fields 'shadows' and 'phaseFunction' are not yet implemented.
summary: ShadedVolumeStyle applies traditional local illumination to volume data by shading only surface voxels, ignoring source values except for normal determination.
